notes: Evaluates Workflow Step 07 (Merge) enforcement: tier-conditional gate checks (Gate 2 + Gate 3 at Medium/High vs Gate 2 only at Low), #branch-strategy-binding integration branch resolution, rebase + test re-run, --no-verify prohibition, and archive handoff.

evals.name: blocks-medium-high-without-maintainer-approval
evals.prompt: Merge High-tier ticket ACME-105 whose code review passed with 0 blockers, but maintainer_approved_at is still empty.
evals.expected_output: Halts fail-closed because High-tier changes require Gate 3 Maintainer Acceptance (maintainer_approved_at set) in addition to Gate 2 code review; directs operator to /cadence-maintain.
assertions: Normalizes tier=High from metadata.yaml and resolves integration branch from #branch-strategy-binding
Refuses merge when maintainer_approved_at is missing at Medium/High tier
Directs operator to run /cadence-maintain without bypassing hooks or gates

evals.name: low-tier-skips-gate3-and-resolves-bound-branch
evals.prompt: Merge Low-tier ticket ACME-109 after Gate 2 code review approved with 0 blocking findings.
evals.expected_output: Verifies Gate 2 approval and resolves integration branch dynamically from #branch-strategy-binding (e.g. trunk or develop), rebases/verifies tests via offload_log_triage if behind, confirms merge, sets status: merged + UTC merged_at, syncs tracker, cleans worktree, and hands off to /cadence-archive.
assertions: Does NOT block Low-tier merge for missing maintainer_approved_at
Resolves integration-branch dynamically from CADENCE_ORG.md#branch-strategy-binding without hardcoding main or develop
Updates status: merged with exact UTC second-precision merged_at and chains /cadence-archive unless --no-archive is set

evals.name: conflict-resolution-escalates-deep-reasoning-and-retests
evals.prompt: While merging BTG-142, its branch is behind the integration branch and hits a non-trivial code merge conflict.
evals.expected_output: Delegates code conflict resolution to cadence-implementer (Deep-reasoning, xhigh effort) in the ticket worktree rather than blindly using --ours/--theirs, re-runs canonical tests through offload_log_triage, and runs offload_deep_review before merging.
assertions: Delegates non-trivial code conflict resolution to Deep-reasoning (xhigh effort)
Re-runs tests with offload_log_triage and runs offload_deep_review after conflict resolution
